capabilities: Set each line's direction from the majority of its words
Ignore code, URLs, links, math and list markers when counting words
Keep fenced code blocks and math blocks left-to-right
Align lists, quotes and tables to their dominant direction
Configure the RTL threshold and excluded folders
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README also exists in Persian (فارسی).
intentEvidence: Obsidian picks the direction of each line from its first letter. That works for pure Persian, Arabic or Hebrew.
problem: Obsidian picks a line's text direction from its first letter, so a mostly Persian or Arabic line starting with an English word is displayed left-to-right and becomes hard to read.
summary: Per-line RTL direction fixer that sets each line's direction from the majority of its words, so mixed Persian/Arabic/English lines read right-to-left.
